message: "Hey, sir. Check this out." This really is the new media generation -- there's apparently a lot of student filmmaking going on. Some of it's dangerous pranks or homophobic anti-Navy humor, and some of it's just cadets being goofy. The chain of command encourages it to a degree, but notes that it's evidence that cadets may not be as overscheduled as they often complain. And last week, the brigade tac officer showed us an absolutely wonderful video that they're going to release for the Army-Navy game -- so I hope I'll have a link to that to post sometime in early December.
